notes.title: A Glimpse into Heroism
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Pilots![/h1]

[b]Thank you[/b] for playing Accident: The Pilot! We hope you enjoyed stepping into the role of a life-saving journalist. Now it’s time to talk about the full version of Accident—because the real adventure begins there!

[b]What’s New in the Full Version?[/b]
[list]
[*] More Rescue Missions: From minor crashes to chain-reaction accidents, face complex challenges and save lives under pressure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37996809/245b831cf495b87b8a023389db70ed1d9f8867c7.gif[/img]
[*] Deeper Investigations: Reconstruct events and uncover the truth behind every accident.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37996809/391be0d1545fc86bc74e8b91b1d0043210919345.gif[/img]
[*] Advanced Scenarios: Navigate through extreme weather and time-sensitive missions for even greater immersion.
[/list]

The pilot version was just the beginning. The full game expands your responsibilities, challenges your skills, and immerses you in emotional, high-stakes situations.

[b]Take the Next Step[/b]
If you enjoyed the thrill of Accident: The Pilot, the full version will leave you on the edge of your seat. Are you ready to save more lives and uncover the truth?

[u]P.S. Our friends are creating a fantastic game called Car Dealer Simulator! Check out their trailer here: [previewyoutube=sD_JJ6GSBaQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Exploring Accident's Diverse Locations
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Rescuers![/h1]

Today, we’re thrilled to take you on a virtual tour of some of the remarkable locations you’ll encounter while investigating road accidents in our game, Accident. From the serene Italian Alps to the bustling streets of American cities, Accident offers a wide variety of environments that not only challenge your skills but also provide a unique and immersive experience. Let's dive into these exciting locations!

[h2]Italian Alps: Serenity Meets Danger[/h2]

Our journey begins in the breathtaking Italian Alps. This picturesque location, with its towering mountains and winding roads, is a sight to behold. However, its beauty is matched by the danger of navigating these treacherous roads. Sharp turns, and steep cliffs make every investigation here a thrilling challenge. Your quick thinking and precision are crucial to save lives and uncover the truth behind each accident.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37996809/e49d720b46fd0c074634f8a05811c6ea83cf6e02.gif[/img]
[h2]Russian Tundra: Cold and Isolated[/h2]

Next, we travel to the frosty expanses of the Russian Tundra. This harsh, snowy landscape presents unique challenges with its icy roads and remote locations. The isolation and extreme cold mean that every second counts when responding to an accident. The stark beauty of the tundra hides numerous perils, making your job even more critical.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37996809/cbc9e827511116fce4908e7ae220a2ccf381ab57.gif[/img]
[h2]American Cities: Urban Chaos[/h2]

From the remote wilderness, we move to the bustling, chaotic streets of American cities.  Navigating through the urban jungle requires keen observation and quick reflexes to manage the scene and ensure everyone's safety.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37996809/d3a82b8d3e9b2d17a3d2795f544e18deddf74015.gif[/img]
And Many More...

Accident’s world is vast and varied, with many more unique locations waiting to be explored. Each environment offers distinct challenges and surprises, ensuring that no two investigations are ever the same.

This is just a glimpse of the diverse settings you’ll experience in Accident. Each location is meticulously designed to provide a realistic and engaging backdrop for your investigations. We can’t wait for you to explore these places and uncover the stories behind each accident.

[b]We know you love free game samples, so we've got something special for you! If you haven't checked it out yet, don't miss the Car Dealer Simulator Prologue. It's a great way to get a taste of what's to come in the full game. 
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115010/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Prologue__Early_Days/

[u]Happy gaming, and stay tuned for more updates![/u]

notes.title: Accident is full-released now with a 30% launch discount!
notes.content:
Accident has officially become a full-released game. We have already shared a major update, so if you have Accident it will be transformed into the full-released game and if you don’t have it yet, it is a great opportunity to buy it with a [b]30% launch discount[/b]. We also invite you to join us on a Developers' Stream, which is on our Steam Page.

With the full release update, we give you a whole [b]new scenario[/b] taking place in the Czech Republic, as well as special [b]video cut-scenes[/b] showing the course of each accident, with which all the previous maps have been enriched. They will add a lot of immersion, because now you’ll be able to actually see what happened, instead of imagining it basing on the clues. You will also see how little it takes to bring about a dangerous incident on the road.

[previewyoutube=-ZeihmzqUSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We are not forgetting about bugs - the full release update contains a lot of bug fixes to the previous maps, making the game a better product.

Last, but not least, Accident gets the Turkish language, which has been asked for a long time.

We hope you will enjoy playing and re-playing the new Accident, so we wish you a lot of fun!
